assertions.description: outbound requests to private ranges must be rejected by the egress proxy

notes: net: 1 endpoint(s) declared but NOT enforced by bwrap alone — bwrap always unshares the net namespace (no host network). To grant egress, a privileged broker MUST launch bwrap inside a pre-created network namespace whose egress honors egress[]. Absent that broker the sandbox has no network. Sharing the host netns is refused by design.
